tasks.title: harness/autowork_parallelism.py — add external-project isolation to can_run_parallel (exact resolved-path membership in _ISOLATED_EXTERNAL_DIRS serializes same-root external tasks; JM self-tasks stay parallel)
acceptance_criteria: harness/autowork_parallelism.py is emitted as a WHOLE-FILE replacement byte-for-byte matching the DISPATCH DIRECTIVE pinned content.
import pathlib appears at the top of the module (not mid-file).
Top-level helper _get_project_dir(task) is present with the exact pinned body (resolves working_dir; maps a working_dir resolving inside this repo, or an absent working_dir, to the repo root).

can_run_parallel inserts the external-isolation check immediately after the same-task-id check and before the files_touched logic, with the exact line: if proj_a == proj_b and proj_a in _ISOLATED_EXTERNAL_DIRS:
There is NO occurrence of the substring test '"NobleGreedv2" not in' and no 'wd_a or wd_b' precondition.
_files_overlap, transitive_deps, _normalize_path and all other can_run_parallel checks (same-task-id, conservative missing files, file overlap, transitive dependency edges) remain byte-identical.
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_autowork_parallelism.py passes — 9 tests GREEN — including test_project_isolation and test_project_isolation_exact_path which are RED on the staged baseline.
No edits to any file other than harness/autowork_parallelism.py; no new tests authored.

spec.objective: Rewrite harness/autowork_parallelism.py so can_run_parallel serializes two tasks whose resolved working_dir lands in the SAME isolated external root (exact resolved-path membership in a new module-level _ISOLATED_EXTERNAL_DIRS, via a new top-level helper _get_project_dir) while JM self-tasks (no working_dir, or a working_dir resolving inside this repo) remain fully parallelizable — making the committed oracle tests/test_autowork_parallelism.py GREEN (9 passed). The file MUST be emitted byte-for-byte as pinned in the DISPATCH DIRECTIVE.
functional_requirements: Add module-level constant _ISOLATED_EXTERNAL_DIRS = frozenset({'/home/xnihil0zer0/NobleGreedv2'}) — the set of external roots whose tasks must serialize, decided by EXACT resolved-path comparison, never a substring test.
Move 'import pathlib' to the module top (the staged baseline has it mid-file); keep 'from __future__ import annotations' as the first statement.

Provide top-level helper _get_project_dir(task) with the exact pinned body: returns the resolved repo root when working_dir is absent or resolves inside this repo (equal to, ancestor of, or descendant of the repo root), otherwise returns the resolved external working_dir; on any exception returns the repo root.

Insert the external-isolation check in can_run_parallel immediately AFTER the same-task-id check and BEFORE the files_touched logic: compute proj_a/proj_b via _get_project_dir and return False only when 'proj_a == proj_b and proj_a in _ISOLATED_EXTERNAL_DIRS'.

Leave _files_overlap, transitive_deps, _normalize_path and every other can_run_parallel admission rule (conservative missing files, file overlap, transitive dependency edges) byte-identical; do NOT change any signature.

Emit the COMPLETE replacement file (whole-file emission) exactly as pinned — never a __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ symbol patch, never a manifest, never a dotted qualname; contains exactly five top-level defs and the constant, with no '"NobleGreedv2" not in' substring test.
spec.interfaces: Public/internal symbols unchanged in signature: _files_overlap(a_files, b_files) -> bool; transitive_deps(task_id, all_tasks) -> set[str]; _normalize_path(p) -> tuple[str, bool]; can_run_parallel(task_a, task_b, all_tasks=None, *, conservative_missing_files=True) -> bool. NEW top-level helper _get_project_dir(task) -> str and NEW module-level constant _ISOLATED_EXTERNAL_DIRS: frozenset[str].
edge_cases: test_project_isolation: two tasks with working_dir '/home/xnihil0zer0/NobleGreedv2' and disjoint files ⇒ can_run_parallel False; both-working_dir-absent disjoint files ⇒ True; one external + one bare self-task ⇒ True; JM-repo-root working_dir on both ⇒ True.

test_project_isolation_exact_path: two tasks sharing working_dir '/home/xnihil0zer0/JanusMaskJR/fixtures/NobleGreedv2-samples' ⇒ True, and two tasks sharing '/home/xnihil0zer0/NobleGreedv2-other' ⇒ True — substring-containing paths are NOT isolated (exact resolved-path membership only).
test_transitive_deps_cycle: transitive dependency resolution terminates on cyclic dependency graphs (visited-set guard) and the dependency-edge admission rule remains intact.
non_goals: Do NOT touch harness/config.yaml (parallel_cap stays 5; JM self-task serialization was REJECTED by the owner).
Do NOT touch harness/autowork_daemon.py, harness/orchestrator.py, harness/git_integration.py, or any other module.
Do NOT author or modify any test — the committed oracle tests/test_autowork_parallelism.py is authoritative.
Do NOT implement general same-project serialization — only exact membership in _ISOLATED_EXTERNAL_DIRS isolates.
Do NOT use substring matching on paths; do NOT preserve the staged baseline's 'if "NobleGreedv2" not in proj_a' logic or its 'wd_a or wd_b' precondition.
Do NOT add new dependencies, network, wall-clock, randomness, or logging; do NOT change any signature; integration/e2e testing is out of scope.
